capabilities: Sync whole vaults, including hidden folders, across devices
Relay end-to-end encrypted mailbox bundles through a self-hosted Cloudflare Worker
Browse per-file history and restore deleted files
extras: The relay is self-hosted on the user's own Cloudflare account; the README warns to back up the vault before the first sync, notes that iOS cannot sync in the background, and states there is no telemetry or analytics.
problem: Keeping a full vault, including plugins, themes and settings, identical across your own devices usually means depending on a third-party sync service.

relations.evidence: hand off end-to-end encrypted "mailbox" bundles through a self-hosted relay on Cloudflare Workers
Under Settings you can add TURN credentials (Cloudflare Realtime) for strict networks (optional)

summary: Peer-to-peer sync for a whole Obsidian vault, including attachments and .obsidian settings, over WebRTC with an encrypted relay fallback.
